spans.text:
High scores are rare and must be
explicitly justified with concrete evidence from the text.
spans.note: The prompt strongly promotes truthfulness and evidence-based evaluation. It explicitly requires conservative scoring grounded in textual evidence, prohibits inferring author intent, and mandates stating 'Not evidenced in the text' when evidence is missing. Anti-inflation rules further enforce honest, calibrated assessments.

spans.text: For each scoring axis, evaluate ONLY what is explicitly written.
spans.note: The prompt promotes fairness through its structured, evidence-based scoring methodology with explicit anti-inflation rules and calibrated scoring anchors. The requirement to evaluate 'ONLY what is explicitly written' and not infer intent helps ensure neutral, unbiased evaluation. The consistent application of hard caps and penalties across all papers promotes equitable treatment.
